baseline_models.focus_anchor: The address to the messenger, the doubled intensive listeners, the absent other group, and the two speech scenes.
baseline_models.mechanism: A message-relay is captured between sender and adjudicator: intensive listeners receive for an absent constituency, circulate falsehood, and negotiate in advance which delivered result will be accepted.

activation_trace.role: The messenger-and-message branch supplies the authorized carrier against which an alternate relay can be seen.
Hearing as understanding and compliance makes the doubled listeners operational receivers, not passive ears.
Falsehood supplies the corrupted content moving through the receiver network.
Speech as negotiation links the mouth-level faith claim to the later prearranged acceptance rule.
The opened mouth in speech marks the exposed interface through which the relay presents a claim.

changed_reading.before: The ayah denounces isolated liars who alter words.
changed_reading.after: The ayah maps an organized information circuit that captures, filters, and redistributes an authorized message for clients who remain offstage.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction 'they deflect the words after their positions' at words 27-31.
baseline_models.mechanism: Distortion is a positional operation: a meaningful unit is tilted away from its assigned coordinate after placement, and the word-as-wound branch makes that displacement injurious rather than merely paraphrastic.

activation_trace.role: Deflection from a direction supplies the lateral operation performed on the words.
A bodily wound supplies the material image by which displaced speech leaves a damaging trace.
Ordered afterness makes tampering a second-stage act performed after an earlier placement.
Placement in an assigned location supplies the stable coordinate from which the unit is moved.

changed_reading.before: Distortion means changing the wording or meaning in general.
changed_reading.after: Distortion is post-placement relocation: words are made to miss their proper directional, sequential, or functional slots, producing a wound in the system they govern.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of divine willing, fitna, human non-possession, and the denied purification of hearts.
baseline_models.mechanism: The heart is treated as the core material under assay. Fitna exposes its composition, purification would remove its contamination, and the messenger is explicitly denied the power to hold that process together or control its outcome.

activation_trace.role: Assaying metal or a person supplies the diagnostic process that reveals hidden composition.
Strength and cohesion define the control the messenger cannot supply against the divine process.
The pure core or pith makes the repeated hearts the interior material whose quality is being disclosed.
Purity as removal of contamination supplies the unrealized counter-process to the assay.
The two acts of willing frame exposure and purification as coordinated outcomes rather than accidental states.

changed_reading.before: Fitna is simply a punishment imposed on an already corrupt person.
changed_reading.after: Fitna also functions as an assay that makes a mouth-heart mismatch legible; non-purification names the disclosed condition, while the messenger cannot control the assay.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Rushing into kufr immediately precedes faith spoken by mouths but not settled in hearts.
baseline_models.mechanism: Speed drives a split between an open verbal surface and a covered core: the public interface can declare trust while the interior never reaches the stillness that the faith root images.

activation_trace.role: Speed as the opposite of slowness supplies the temporal pressure under which the split operates.
Covering supplies the direction of the rush: movement into concealment rather than only toward a label.
Trustful assent that settles the heart supplies the state claimed at the surface but negated in the interior.
The mouth opened in speech supplies the fast public surface of the declaration.
The core or pith supplies the slower interior whose lack of assent and purification brackets the ayah.

changed_reading.before: Rushing into unbelief is generic eagerness to do wrong.
changed_reading.after: The rush is a high-speed concealment strategy in which public speech gets ahead of, and masks, an unconverted interior.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent parallel intensives turn the relay into an appetite economy: repeated listening is paired with repeated devouring, so false information is selected because it yields consumable illicit advantage.

activation_trace.role: Understanding that issues in compliance makes the focus listeners usable agents in a transaction.
The repeated intensive listener carries the same compliant intake mechanism into the adjacent ayah.
Consuming and taking wealth supplies the material payoff paired with informational intake.
Illicit and defective gain identifies what this appetite economy consumes.

structural_cues: 5:42 places the intensive listener and intensive eater in a balanced sequence, each with a governed object.
The focus ayah's accept-this/avoid-that instruction already makes reception conditional on payoff.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel intensive agent nouns plus hearing-as-compliance and eating-as-taking-wealth; I infer one intake economy linking information to gain. A live alternative is that the two intensives merely list separate vices.

changed_reading.before: The listeners prefer lies because they are credulous or hostile.
changed_reading.after: They operate a market in outcomes: false reports are eagerly ingested and relayed because those reports feed an illicit material or institutional appetite.

context_deltas.mechanism: Positional distortion becomes a breach of entrusted custody that enables forum-shopping: parties solicit a ruling while holding an existing rule, and custodians can exchange witnessed signs for a small countervalue.

activation_trace.role: Deflection from direction supplies the custodial breach performed on the received wording.
An assigned placement supplies the textual or juridical station custody should preserve.
Delegating judgment supplies the act of selecting a second forum despite an available ruling.
Guarding and watching supplies the entrusted custodial duty that distortion violates.
Testimony as knowledgeable declaration makes custodians publicly accountable for what was preserved.
Exchange through sale or purchase supplies the conversion of entrusted signs into negotiated advantage.
Price as exchange-value supplies the small incentive for custodial displacement.

structural_cues: 5:43 asks why they seek the messenger's judgment while possessing a divine judgment and then turning away.
5:44 joins entrusted preservation, witness, judgment, and a prohibition on exchanging signs for a small price.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an available ruling, delegated judgment, preservation, witness, and exchange-value; I infer that moving words from position is the enabling breach behind outcome-driven forum choice. The live alternative is simple inconsistency without an organized custody failure.

changed_reading.before: Words are distorted chiefly to falsify doctrine.
changed_reading.after: Words are displaced within a custody system so clients can bypass an unfavorable rule, shop for a usable verdict, and reward the custodians who make that route possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's wounded word and assigned positions activate against a legal grid of matched body-parts and wounds. Distortion can therefore be read as breaking prescribed correspondences, not only changing lexical content.

activation_trace.role: The word-root's bodily wound branch makes the textual unit materially comparable to the wounds in the later rule.
Assigned placement supplies the correct cell in the correspondence grid.
Inscription that establishes an obligatory rule supplies the fixed status of the correspondences.
Cutting the skin and producing a wound makes the focus word-wound branch explicit in the legal sequence.
Matching an injury through requital supplies the one-to-one alignment that tampering disrupts.
Making a rule firm and exact supplies the system-level need for stable correspondences.

structural_cues: 5:45 repeatedly aligns like with like: life, eye, nose, ear, tooth, and wounds.
The focus construction combines deflection, words/wounds, temporal afterness, and assigned locations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a word-root with a wound branch and a later rule built from exact bodily matches; I infer a shared correspondence mechanism in which displacement defeats equivalence. A live alternative keeps the wound branch as wordplay without juridical force.

changed_reading.before: Moving words from their places means reordering a text.
changed_reading.after: It can mean breaking the rule's mapping between case and consequence, moving a legally operative unit into the wrong slot so an injury no longer receives its assigned match.

context_deltas.mechanism: A legitimate transmission chain follows surviving traces, confirms prior material, and supervises it. The focus's absent client-group and post-placement deflection form a rival chain that interrupts traceable custody.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and message supply the authorized endpoint of the transmission chain.
Deflection from direction supplies the break by which a rival chain departs from its trace.
Following a trace in sequence supplies the continuity expected of a legitimate successor.
A surviving sign of what preceded supplies the inspectable evidence that continuity follows.
Making a claim true in action supplies confirmation as performed continuity rather than verbal assertion.
Witnessing and supervisory care supply the oversight that keeps inherited material inspectable.
Ordered letters and the written artifact supply the durable object passed through the chain.

structural_cues: 5:46 twice presents confirmation of what is already before the successor.
5:48 combines confirmation, supervision, and judgment while warning against following interested desires.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sequential trace-following, durable signs, confirmation, and supervision; I infer a provenance chain. The alternative is a theological succession sequence with no procedural implication for the focus relay.

changed_reading.before: The absent group merely sends representatives to hear a ruling.
changed_reading.after: Two provenance systems compete: one follows, confirms, and supervises inherited traces, while the other inserts offstage clients and redirects material after it has entered custody.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later near-repetition exposes the proximate form of the focus fitna: interested parties try to tilt the adjudicator away from some portion of what was delivered, while the command to beware blocks selective uptake.

activation_trace.role: Turning someone from the right direction supplies the focus fitna's manipulable social mechanism.
Alert self-protection supplies the clients' conditional avoidance rule.
Judgment between people identifies the decision point the pressure campaign targets.
Putting something in its proper station supplies the delivered norm from which selective pressure would displace it.
The inclination of desire supplies the directional pull exerted on judgment.
Alert avoidance is redirected toward protecting the adjudicator from capture, reversing the focus clients' use of caution.
Deflection from the right course names the attempted capture directly in the later scene.
A divided portion supplies the selective scope: the aim is displacement from only some of what was delivered.
Willing supplies the later divine framing of the consequences produced through that selective attempt.

structural_cues: 5:49 repeats caution, fitna, divine willing, and judgment vocabulary from the focus scene.
The focus's take-this/avoid-that rule is selective; 5:49 explicitly speaks of being turned from some of what was delivered.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later attempted deflection from part of a delivered norm and repeats the focus's caution, fitna, and willing sequence; I infer that the social pressure is a proximate instrument of the assay. A live alternative treats the two fitna constructions as unrelated senses.

changed_reading.before: God's willing of fitna is an opaque event detached from the parties' behavior.
changed_reading.after: The ayah also exposes an assay enacted through selective adjudicative pressure: their own outcome-filtering attempt becomes the event that reveals and fixes the heart's condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact later rush occurs in diseased hearts fearing a reversal of fortune. This gives the focus haste a social-temporal engine: rapid alignment is a hedge against anticipated regime change, and public declarations keep multiple futures open.

activation_trace.role: Speed supplies the focus behavior whose motive the later echo discloses.
The inner core supplies the location where declared trust fails to settle.
Disease of the heart makes the later core explicitly pathological rather than merely undecided.
Weakening and curtailed movement supply the impaired interior that paradoxically produces hurried external movement.
The exact speed image repeats the focus motion inside a disclosed alliance scene.
Fear with apprehensive regard supplies the motive confessed for the rush.
The circulation of changing conditions supplies the anticipated turn against which the actors hedge.

structural_cues: 5:52 repeats the same rushing form and again places it in hearts.
Its speakers explicitly justify the rush by fear that a turn of fortune will strike them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact rush echo, diseased hearts, fear, and rotating circumstances; I infer risk-hedging through rapid affiliation. The alternative is a narrower alliance episode that should not determine every instance of rushing in the focus.

changed_reading.before: The actors rush because unbelief itself attracts them.
changed_reading.after: Their haste can be read as portfolio-like political hedging: a diseased core fears the next turn, so mouth-level loyalty and rapid alignment are optimized for whichever side appears usable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mouth-heart split matures into a credentialing performance: spoken faith is reinforced by maximal oaths, but the performance cannot stabilize the underlying acts, which collapse when the concealed alignment is exposed.

activation_trace.role: The mouth opened in speech supplies the public credentialing surface.
Assent that should settle in the heart supplies the substance absent beneath the declaration.
Articulated speech supplies the public report evaluating the failed claim.
Heart-settled assent supplies the identity claimed under oath.
An oath distributed upon its parties supplies the formal strengthening of the public credential.
The oath branch identifies the emphatic instrument used to certify the claim.
Falling and sinking supply the failure of the over-certified performance.
Purposive acts supply the underlying record that verbal credentials cannot preserve.

structural_cues: The focus contrasts a spoken faith claim with hearts that did not assent.
5:53 recalls strenuous oaths of belonging and immediately announces the collapse of their acts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mouth-only faith, later maximal oaths, and failed acts; I infer that oath intensity compensates for weak interior commitment. The alternative is that the oaths and collapsed works concern a different group dynamic.

changed_reading.before: The mouth-only claim is a simple verbal lie.
changed_reading.after: It is a deliberately over-certified social credential: speech and oath manufacture visible belonging while the action record remains structurally unable to support it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The burial image is cross-domain and should be rendered as an activation, not as a claim that the focus narrates a literal killing. It remains anchored in the focus roots for covering, wounded words, and assigned places, while 5:31 supplies concealment of a bodily trace.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Rushing into covering and moving the word-as-wound away from its assigned place.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the focus movement toward concealment.
The bodily wound branch supplies the damaged trace that concealment seeks to hide.
Assigned placement supplies the evidentiary location from which the trace is removed.
Hiding something behind visibility supplies the context's burial-like method for suppressing an exposed trace.

changed_reading.before: Kufr and distortion are two adjacent but separate offenses.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, rushing into covering is the motive and moving wounded words is the burial operation: a damaging trace is removed from where it could testify.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Linking zakat's purity branch to denied heart-purification is branch-sensitive and should not erase zakat's concrete ritual-social sense. The reading remains anchored in the explicit focus purification verb and is useful as a contrast between claimed interior status and enacted outward alignment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The denied purification of hearts at the close of the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: Removing moral defect from self and action supplies the focus's denied interior transformation.
Purity and soundness supply an enacted counterpart to the focus's unrealized heart-purification.
Bowing as humility supplies the bodily posture through which interior alignment becomes observable.

changed_reading.before: Purification in 5:41 is an invisible state discussed only as divine action.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the later purity-and-bowing cluster supplies an enacted contrast: genuine alignment becomes socially and bodily legible, unlike the focus's mouth-only credential.

strongest_changes: The doubled listening becomes an illicit intake economy when paired with doubled devouring in 5:42.
Distortion becomes a custodial and adjudicative operation enabling outcome-driven forum-shopping.
The 5:49 repetition identifies selective pressure on judgment as a proximate mechanism of fitna.
The exact rush echo in 5:52 recasts haste as political risk-hedging by diseased hearts.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly converted interior vice into inspectable infrastructure: relay, appetite, custody, correspondence, provenance, selective adjudication, and hedging all remain anchored in the focus ayah's words and constructions.
remaining_uncertainties: The wound-and-correspondence model may be a productive branch activation rather than the dominant syntactic force of 'words after their positions.'
The assay reading does not settle how divine willing relates causally to the actors' prior choices.
The burial and enacted-purity outliers should remain explicitly exploratory because their cross-domain arrows are reader-supplied.
